messages:
sarah_cs: Flagging recurring ask from three onboarding calls today  customers need a per-route finance export and one of them called it a renewal blocker. Quick bucket below, plz react.
diego_onboard: saw same in ClearHarbor trial and Helio pilot. Quote: 'we can't sign without line-item route costs for our finance team.'
mike_prod: paste the asks + severity and I'll add to intake board. If it's a renewal blocker we should P0 it.
sarah_cs: Asks: 
- Per-route finance export (high): server-side authoritative CSV + API endpoint. Columns wanted: date, route, environment, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, requests, avg_latency_ms. Export filter by date range and tag. (renewal risk: Brightlane, rev in ~4w)
- Embeddings refresh schedule (medium-high): TTL or cron re-embed for streaming docs.
- Burst-latency toggle (medium): route-level option to prioritize latency over throughput during business hours.
aya_eng: Q: for cost export, do they expect exact billing-calculation parity or an internal estimate? Also any preference for realtime vs daily batch?
diego_onboard: they asked for "authoritative" numbers that finance can reconcile with invoices. Daily batch is fine as long as it's consistent and documented.
mike_prod: Proposed triage: P0 = per-route finance export for accounts with renewals <6w; P1 = embeddings refresh; P2 = burst toggle + onboarding snippets. Will validate impact x confidence in triage.
aya_eng: Technical action: I'll sketch an export schema and a small job to compute daily aggregates. ETA for prototype CSV: 3 business days.
sarah_cs: please mark Brightlane as high-risk in renewal tracker and add this thread to the product sync agenda.
calendar_bot: Reminder: CS/Product sync in 2 days at 10:00am PT. Added thread to agenda under "renewal blockers".
mike_prod: I'll prepare a 5-min wireframe for the export UI for the sync. Also creating GH triage issue and will attach call notes + verbatim quote.
sarah_cs: thanks all. If we can get the CSV sample + LOE before the sync we can push a mitigation email to the customer. :pray:
